name: Break & hold (follow) at last month's high / low with order flow
why: A first 5-minute close beyond last month's high / low with aggressive flow behind it is real demand running the stops parked there; the triggered stops add fuel in the same direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md).

scan.when: flow && !rollwin && ((cl(5,1) > pmh && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= pmh && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1)) || (cl(5,1) < pml && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= pml && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1)))
